role: senior strategy consultant creating the Nexus Home CXO context cockpit

tenant.name: Airline Demo
tenant.boundary: synthetic_demo_airline_planning_grade; not a real airline production dataset

objective: Combine tenant-loaded context with industry movement to explain how the business should run differently, what AI/change bets matter most, and what evidence gates must clear before scale.
ranking_rule: Do not rank by row order. Rank by strategic value, industry urgency, client fit, data/system readiness, risk/control maturity, sponsorship evidence, and dependency leverage.
style: Boardroom-ready strategy language. No product jargon, no raw IDs, no generic AI hype, no unsupported realized value claims.

narrative_sections.enterprise_brief_summary: Airline Demo now has an approved Home design pack sourced from active tenant CSVs. The cockpit should tell a CXO what context is loaded, why it matters for AI success, which evidence is missing, and where Intelligence, Moves, Source, and Tower should take over.
narrative_sections.context_confidence_summary: Context confidence separates loaded data from board-grade truth. Stronger answers require source-owner validation, relationship materialization, and evidence lineage.
narrative_sections.evidence_gaps_summary: Evidence gaps are framed as business blockers: what cannot be claimed yet, what source evidence is needed, and which module should own the next action.
narrative_sections.use_cases_summary: AI opportunities are planning-grade until the required systems, data, controls, owners, and value evidence are confirmed.
narrative_sections.proof_summary: The proof tab shows source files, row counts, dates, owners when supplied, fields loaded, and the evidence boundary behind the cockpit.

proof_relationship_visual.title: Context becomes a relationship graph
proof_relationship_visual.caption: Active source rows are converted into a planning-grade graph so aVa can reason across functions, systems, data, vendors, programs, processes, and risks.

dimensions.name: Enterprise Profile
dimensions.summary: Airline Demo is a complex global passenger airline with cargo, loyalty, maintenance, and digital operations.

dimensions.name: Business Functions
dimensions.summary: Flight operations, crew management, customer experience, maintenance, and sourcing are the primary AI-relevant functions.

dimensions.name: Org Ownership
dimensions.summary: Policy content ownership and data governance accountability are not yet assigned across critical use cases.

dimensions.name: Workforce Roles
dimensions.summary: Crew planners, contact center agents, maintenance technicians, and sourcing analysts are primary AI-adjacent roles.

dimensions.name: Applications & Systems
dimensions.summary: Fourteen systems span reservations, crew, maintenance, baggage, CRM, loyalty, ITSM, and data platforms.

dimensions.name: Data Assets & Integrations
dimensions.summary: Key data domains including disruption lineage, bag scans, maintenance events, and transcripts lack certification.

dimensions.name: Infrastructure & Platforms
dimensions.summary: AWS airline data lakehouse is a target-state platform; current-state certification evidence is not yet confirmed.

dimensions.name: Vendors & Contracts
dimensions.summary: Eight vendors including NorthSky Managed Services and AeroCore anchor critical operational and IT delivery.

dimensions.name: IT Budget, Spend & Value
dimensions.summary: Flight operations, crew management, customer experience, maintenance, and sourcing are the primary AI-relevant functions.

dimensions.name: Programs & Initiatives
dimensions.summary: Seven active use-case programs span sourcing, operations, customer experience, and analytics modernization.

dimensions.name: AI & Automation Use Cases
dimensions.summary: Airline Demo is a complex global passenger airline with cargo, loyalty, maintenance, and digital operations.

dimensions.name: Risks & Controls
dimensions.summary: Risk spans managed-services contract gaps, uncertified data lineage, and unvalidated AI governance controls.

dimensions.name: Relationships
dimensions.summary: CIO, CTO, and CDAO teams share overlapping priorities but cross-functional alignment is not yet evidenced.

dimensions.name: Evidence Sources
dimensions.summary: Current evidence is planning-grade and synthetic; no production-certified data, contracts, or outcomes are claimed.

dimensions.name: Metrics & Outcomes
dimensions.summary: No certified operational, financial, or customer-experience baselines exist to anchor outcome measurement.

dimensions.name: Industry Context Patterns
dimensions.summary: IROPS sensitivity, crew legality complexity, and managed-services dependency are common airline transformation risks.

dimensions.name: Expert Lenses
dimensions.summary: Legal, procurement, data governance, AI ethics, and operational safety expertise are required across use cases.

dimensions.name: Managed Services Scope
dimensions.summary: NorthSky Managed Services anchors AMS and IMS delivery; scope, SLAs, and exit terms are not yet validated.

dimensions.name: Operational Process Evidence
dimensions.summary: Risk spans managed-services contract gaps, uncertified data lineage, and unvalidated AI governance controls.
